Fixed. Bug: comparison used `>` instead of `>=`. Session valid only while `now < expiresAt`; at the exact millisecond when they're equal, it must be invalid.

Changed line 3 from `return now > expiresAt;` to `return now >= expiresAt;`

This propagates through middleware (rejects expired sessions), refresh API (blocks refresh on expiry), and cleanup job (filters expired sessions).
